name: AWS CloudTrail - Detect Sts Get Session Token Abuse

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail (GetSessionToken IAMUser)
| parse "\"eventName\":\"*\"" as event_name | where event_name="GetSessionToken"
| parse "\"userIdentity\":{\"type\":\"*\"" as type | where type="IAMUser"
// EOQ

description: This search provides detection of suspicious use of sts:GetSessionToken. These tokens can be created on the go and used by attackers to move laterally and escalate privileges.
